verdict.rationale: RingCentral offers a public developer API platform, so versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versions, a version scheme, or a deprecation or sunset policy. Item docs-5 has a release-notes URL, but its content is only getting-started navigation links, which says nothing about versioning or deprecation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
